changes: Independent arithmetic, conversion, bitwise, comparison, shift and rotate implementation.
Validate every integer digit and radix; bounded native decimal conversion and constant-space word accumulation.
Independent mutable small integers and frozen shared constants.
Exactly eight validated bytes, including cross-realm Uint8Arrays.
Preserve receiver-directed mixed-signedness semantics and wire compatibility.

implementation.basis: New mutable-word value implementation, independently assembled memory-free WebAssembly multiply/divide/remainder kernel, and native BigInt fallback. No upstream arithmetic runtime or binary is retained. Public type contracts and licenses retain attribution.
implementation.targetScope: The long 5.3.2 value API, including actual protobufjs, proto-loader and Google SDK integer paths.
